up: Retrieve IC50 activity values (in nM) for compounds tested against human JAK1 (target CHEMBL2835). For each activity, include: compound canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI (prefer PubMed ID if available), assay description, and target details (target name and organism). Filter for exact IC50 values (standard_relation = '='), with units in nM. Do not limit the number of rows.
sql:
SELECT
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  CASE WHEN d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL THEN d.pubmed_id ELSE d.doi END AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2835'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
